t: The Hive V4 wireless heating smart thermostat delivers intelligent temperature control for combi boilers with proactive heating that activates only when needed. This touchscreen thermostat works seamlessly with Amazon Alexa, Apple HomeKit and Google Home, plus iOS and Android apps for convenient remote management from anywhere. The battery-powered device features automatic frost protection for pipes, temperature graphs tracking heating usage, and a 7-day programmable schedule with multiple on/off periods. OpenTherm compatible and suitable for wet underfloor heating systems, the Hive V4 optimises boiler efficiency whilst reducing wear and tear, with a supplied smart hub managing your home's heating intelligently. Version 4 of the 3rd Generation.
